content.comment_body: Hello, I have 10 [product_name] modules with Ethernet capability and need to connect them using [product_name] engineering software version [version_no]. In the HMI connections menu, I can't find a communication driver for [product_name]; available options include [version_no] and OPC, but not [product_name]. Can anyone advise? Thank you.
If there's an option for [version_no], try using that.
Hello, There isn't an option for [version_no]; only [version_no] and OPC are listed.

Hi, [product_name] is not available in [product_name] engineering software directly. However, you can connect [product_name] with the HMI. You can configure [product_name] in its configuration software, using Tools > Parameter VM mapping. See the provided application example. Be careful: inputs and bit memory can be overwritten by [product_name]. Hope this helps. Thanks & Regards
Beginning with version 12 of [product_name] visualization software, the '[product_name]' driver is included. Refer to the attachment for details.

A new question from [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Unable to connect [product_name] engineering software version [version_no] to [product_name] version [version_no]'. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulty finding the [product_name] communication driver in [product_name] engineering software version [version_no], which prevents straightforward selection and connection of [product_name] modules via the HMI interface. Multiple responses confirm the absence of direct [product_name] support in this edition, offering alternative methods or recommending checking for newer software versions with improved driver availability. This limitation leads to confusion and increases the integration effort for those seeking Ethernet-based connectivity with [product_name] modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate the [product_name] driver to be present in [product_name] engineering software version [version_no], enabling straightforward HMI integration and device connectivity.
